name: A Test of Courage
source: Alice just wanted candy. Instead, she got a cursed party, a malfunctioning robot, and a swarm of zombies. A parody-packed Halloween story where breaking the fourth wall is the least of your problems.
translation: 爱丽丝只是想要糖果。相反，她得到了一个被诅咒的队伍、一个出现故障的机器人和一群僵尸。一个充满恶搞的万圣节故事，打破第四堵墙是你最不遇到的问题。
